structural-causal.name: alignment2036
structural-causal.basis: AI infrastructure requires specialized compute, switching and optical connectivity.

structural-causal.name: crossDivisionLeverage
structural-causal.basis: Custom silicon and connectivity IP can be co-designed around hyperscaler architectures.

structural-causal.name: bottleneckControl
structural-causal.basis: Electro-optics and custom silicon address bandwidth and specialized-compute constraints.

structural-causal.name: scenarioRobustness
structural-causal.basis: Connectivity and custom compute provide multiple AI paths, but data center is now 79% of revenue.

structural-causal.name: supplyChainResilience
structural-causal.basis: Fabless model depends on limited advanced wafer, substrate, packaging and test suppliers.

discovery-weak-signals.name: AI infrastructure exposure
discovery-weak-signals.basis: Record revenue and accelerating data-center growth.

adversarial-red-team.name: scenarioRobustness
adversarial-red-team.basis: Strong AI demand is offset by heavy data-center and major-customer exposure.

adversarial-red-team.name: substitutionResilience
adversarial-red-team.basis: Deep custom integration raises switching friction, but customers can internalize or re-source designs.

adversarial-red-team.name: supplyChainResilience
adversarial-red-team.basis: Limited qualified advanced wafer, substrate, packaging and test suppliers are explicit dependencies.

adversarial-red-team.name: pricingPower
adversarial-red-team.basis: Record growth does not by itself establish durable program-level pricing power.

expectations-execution.name: Execution versus expectations
expectations-execution.basis: Revenue exceeded guidance midpoint and cash generation remained substantial.

items.risk: AI/custom-silicon demand can be concentrated in a limited set of hyperscale programs.
High AI expectations raise the future delivery bar.
Data center concentration makes the company more sensitive to hyperscaler AI capex and program timing.
Advanced manufacturing dependencies can delay otherwise successful designs.
High data-center concentration can amplify a hyperscaler capex or architecture reset.
Bookings and design wins are not equivalent to guaranteed production revenue; ramps can be delayed, resized or lost.
Customer vertical integration is both a market opportunity for custom silicon and a substitution threat to merchant products/programs.
